verdicts.reason: San Diego's Residential Tenant Protections ordinance (D073) only requires a notice pointing tenants to the state rent cap in Civil Code 1947.12. No document states that San Diego lacks a local rent increase limit or is barred from adopting one. The retrieved rent cap passages concern other cities or general state law.

D073 mentions only that relocation assistance is in addition to the return of any deposit owed. No document addresses whether San Diego has or lacks a security deposit rule. The retrieved deposit passages concern other jurisdictions.
The retrieved screening fee passages are Civil Code 1950.6 text and Berkeley materials. None says anything about San Diego having or lacking a local screening fee rule.

D073 only notes that a landlord re-offering a unit after a no-fault eviction may screen the displaced tenant using industry accepted methods. This does not establish that San Diego has no screening restrictions. Other retrieved passages concern state law or other jurisdictions.
